description: A comprehensive system of divination and spiritual symbolism using a deck of 78 cards, integrating elements of astrology, numerology, and Kabbalah.

core_systems.title: The Major Arcana
core_systems.summary: The 22 trump cards representing major life themes and spiritual lessons.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.description: A young person standing at the edge of a cliff, carrying a white rose and a small bundle, accompanied by a white dog. The figure appears carefree and ready to step off into the unknown.
cards.upright_meaning: New beginnings, fresh starts, innocence, spontaneity, free spirit, taking risks, following your heart
cards.reversed_meaning: Recklessness, carelessness, risk-taking, poor judgment, naivety

cards.name: The Magician
cards.description: A figure standing before a table with the four suits of the tarot (wand, cup, sword, pentacle) representing mastery over the elements. Above their head is the infinity symbol, and they point both above and below.
cards.upright_meaning: Manifestation, resourcefulness, power, inspired action, divine guidance
cards.reversed_meaning: Manipulation, poor planning, untapped talents, wasted energy

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.description: A female figure seated between two pillars (Boaz and Jachin), with a crescent moon at her feet. She holds a scroll of esoteric knowledge and wears the crown of Isis.
cards.upright_meaning: Intuition, sacred knowledge, divine mystery, inner voice, unconscious mind
cards.reversed_meaning: Secrets kept, disconnection from intuition, withdrawal, cognitive dissonance

cards.name: The Empress
cards.description: A crowned woman seated on a throne in a lush garden, wearing a robe adorned with pomegranates. She holds a scepter and her shield bears the symbol of Venus.
cards.upright_meaning: Fertility, nurturing, abundance, sensuality, nature, creativity, maternal care
cards.reversed_meaning: Creative blocks, dependence, smothering, lack of growth, domestic problems

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.description: A crowned male figure seated on a stone throne decorated with ram heads. He holds an ankh scepter and orb, symbolizing divine authority and worldly power.
cards.upright_meaning: Authority, establishment, structure, protection, reason, leadership
cards.reversed_meaning: Domination, excessive control, rigidity, inflexibility, lack of discipline

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.description: A religious figure seated between two pillars, wearing triple crown. He holds a staff in his left hand and makes a blessing gesture with his right. Two acolytes kneel before him.
cards.upright_meaning: Spiritual guidance, religious beliefs, tradition, conformity, education, wisdom
cards.reversed_meaning: Challenge to beliefs, unconventionality, new approaches, personal truth

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.description: A naked man and woman stand beneath an angel in a garden setting. Behind them are two trees - one bearing flames, the other bearing fruit. The sun shines above.
cards.upright_meaning: Love, harmony, relationships, values alignment, choices, union, partnerships
cards.reversed_meaning: Disharmony, imbalance, misalignment of values, conflict in relationships

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.description: A crowned figure in armor stands in a chariot drawn by two sphinxes or horses (one black, one white). The canopy of stars represents celestial guidance.
cards.upright_meaning: Control, willpower, victory, assertion, determination, focus, direction
cards.reversed_meaning: Lack of control, aggression, obstacles, lack of direction, defeat

cards.name: Strength
cards.description: A woman gently closes the jaws of a lion, demonstrating mastery through gentleness rather than force. She wears white robes and a crown of flowers, with the infinity symbol above her head.
cards.upright_meaning: Inner strength, courage, persuasion, influence, compassion, patience
cards.reversed_meaning: Self-doubt, weakness, lack of self-discipline, raw emotion

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.description: An elderly figure in a gray cloak stands alone on a mountain peak, holding up a lantern with a six-pointed star inside. In his other hand he holds a staff for support.
cards.upright_meaning: Soul-searching, introspection, being alone, inner guidance, divine wisdom
cards.reversed_meaning: Isolation, loneliness, withdrawal, lost your way, rejection

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.description: A great wheel turns in the heavens, surrounded by mystical figures. The Hebrew letters YHVH appear along with alchemical symbols for the four elements. Sphinxes or creatures rest upon clouds in the corners.
cards.upright_meaning: Good luck, karma, life cycles, destiny, turning point, change
cards.reversed_meaning: Bad luck, resistance to change, breaking cycles, unwelcome change

cards.name: Justice
cards.description: A figure in red robes sits between two pillars, holding a sword in one hand and scales in the other. They wear a crown with a small square representing the law.
cards.upright_meaning: Justice, fairness, truth, cause and effect, law, karma, consequences
cards.reversed_meaning: Unfairness, lack of accountability, dishonesty, unbalanced scales

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.description: A man hangs upside-down from a living wood T-cross, with a peaceful expression. His right leg is bent forming a '4', and there is a halo around his head. His hands are bound behind his back.
cards.upright_meaning: Surrender, new perspective, enlightenment, sacrifice, letting go, suspension
cards.reversed_meaning: Stagnation, delay, resistance, avoiding sacrifice, needless sacrifice

cards.name: Death
cards.description: A skeleton in black armor rides a white horse. Various figures from all classes of life fall before Death. In the background, the sun rises between two towers, while a boat sails on a river.
cards.upright_meaning: Endings, change, transformation, transition, letting go, metamorphosis
cards.reversed_meaning: Resistance to change, inability to move on, stagnation, decay

cards.name: Temperance
cards.description: An angel with solar disk and wings stands with one foot in water, one on land, pouring liquid between two cups. The angel wears a triangle in a square on their robe, representing spirit manifesting in matter.
cards.upright_meaning: Balance, moderation, patience, purpose, meaning, self-control
cards.reversed_meaning: Imbalance, excess, lack of harmony, misalignment, discord

cards.name: The Devil
cards.description: A winged, horned figure sits above two chained human figures. The Devil has bat wings, a reversed pentagram on his forehead, and holds a torch pointing downward. The humans have loose chains they could easily remove.
cards.upright_meaning: Bondage, addiction, materialism, sexuality, shadow self, restriction
cards.reversed_meaning: Breaking free, release, restoring control, detachment, reclaiming power

cards.name: The Tower
cards.description: A tall tower on a rocky outcrop is struck by lightning, its crown falling. Two figures fall from the tower, symbolizing sudden change and upheaval. Flames emerge from the windows.
cards.upright_meaning: Sudden change, upheaval, chaos, revelation, awakening, breaking free
cards.reversed_meaning: Avoiding disaster, fear of change, delaying the inevitable

cards.name: The Star
cards.description: A naked woman kneels by a pool, pouring water onto land and water. Above her, eight stars shine, with one large central star. Birds and flowers surround her in a peaceful scene.
cards.upright_meaning: Hope, faith, purpose, renewal, spirituality, inspiration, serenity
cards.reversed_meaning: Lack of faith, despair, disconnection, discouragement

cards.name: The Moon
cards.description: A full moon with a face shines between two towers. A wolf and dog howl at the moon, while a crayfish emerges from a pool. A path leads between the towers into the distance.
cards.upright_meaning: Illusion, fear, anxiety, subconscious, intuition, dreams
cards.reversed_meaning: Release of fear, repressed emotion, inner confusion

cards.name: The Sun
cards.description: A radiant sun shines above a child riding a white horse. Sunflowers grow in a garden wall behind them. The scene represents pure joy and innocence.
cards.upright_meaning: Joy, success, celebration, positivity, vitality, enlightenment
cards.reversed_meaning: Temporary depression, inner child issues, overly optimistic

cards.name: Judgement
cards.description: An angel blows a trumpet in the heavens, while below, people rise from their graves with arms upraised. The scene represents awakening and rebirth.
cards.upright_meaning: Awakening, rebirth, inner calling, reckoning, absolution, clarity
cards.reversed_meaning: Self-doubt, ignoring the call, refusing change

cards.name: The World
cards.description: A dancing figure in a wreath, surrounded by the four fixed signs of the zodiac (bull, lion, eagle, angel). The figure holds two wands, representing balance and accomplishment.
cards.upright_meaning: Completion, integration, accomplishment, travel, wholeness, success
cards.reversed_meaning: Lack of completion, stagnation, delays in completion

core_systems.title: The Minor Arcana
core_systems.summary: The 56 cards representing everyday forces and influences in life, divided into four elemental suits.

suits.name: Suit of Wands
suits.description: The suit of spiritual and creative energy, representing ambition, inspiration, willpower and enterprise. Associated with the element of Fire and the season of Summer.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.description: A hand emerges from a cloud, grasping a flowering wand. A castle stands in the background with a river flowing before it.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.description: A figure in rich robes stands on battlements holding a globe, with two wands crossed. Roses and lilies decorate the scene.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.description: A merchant stands with his back turned, looking out to sea. Three wands are planted in the ground beside him.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.description: Four wands decorated with flowers and garlands frame a scene of celebration, with people dancing near a castle.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.description: Five figures wielding wands appear to be in conflict or competition with each other.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.description: A rider on horseback wearing a wreath of victory, carrying a decorated wand. A crowd celebrates his triumph with raised wands.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.description: A figure on higher ground defends their position against six attacking wands from below.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.description: Eight wands flying through the air in parallel formation, suggesting swift movement and action.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.description: A wounded but vigilant figure stands guard with a wand, while eight other wands form a defensive wall behind them.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.description: A figure struggles to carry ten heavy wands, bending under their weight as they approach a distant town.

court_cards.name: Page of Wands
court_cards.description: A young figure in a yellow tunic stands in a desert landscape, holding a flowering wand and gazing at it with wonder.

court_cards.name: Knight of Wands
court_cards.description: A knight in orange armor rides a rearing horse, holding a flowering wand aloft, his tunic decorated with salamanders.

court_cards.name: Queen of Wands
court_cards.description: A queen sits on a throne adorned with lions and sunflowers, holding a sunflower in her left hand and a wand in her right, with a black cat at her feet.

court_cards.name: King of Wands
court_cards.description: A king sits on a throne adorned with lions and salamanders, holding a flowering wand like a scepter, wearing robes decorated with salamanders.

suits.name: Suit of Cups
suits.description: The suit of emotions, intuition, relationships, and spiritual connection. Associated with the element of Water, representing feelings, creativity, and the unconscious mind.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.description: A divine hand emerges from a cloud, holding an ornate chalice overflowing with five streams of water. A white dove descends toward the cup, carrying a wafer marked with a cross. Lotus flowers and water lilies float on the surface of a serene sea below.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.description: A young man and woman exchange cups in a ceremony of union. Above them floats the caduceus of Hermes, with a lion's head at its top, symbolizing passion tempered by wisdom.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.description: Three women in flowing dresses dance together in a circle, each raising a cup in celebration. The ground beneath them is rich with fruits and flowers, symbolizing abundance and joy.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.description: A young man sits under a tree in contemplation, arms crossed, looking dissatisfied. Before him are three cups, while a hand emerges from a cloud offering a fourth cup that he seems to ignore.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.description: A figure in a black cloak stands grieving over three spilled cups, while two full cups remain standing behind them. In the background, a bridge crosses a river leading to a distant castle.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.description: Two children in a garden, one passing a cup filled with white flowers to the other. Five more cups with white flowers stand nearby. The scene suggests innocence, nostalgia, and pure emotional connections.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.description: A figure faced with seven cups floating in clouds, each containing different visions: a castle, jewels, a wreath, a dragon, a head, a snake, and a shrouded figure.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.description: A cloaked figure walks away from eight stacked cups under a moon in eclipse. Mountains loom in the background, suggesting a spiritual journey ahead.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.description: A well-dressed merchant sits on a wooden bench, arms crossed in satisfaction, with nine golden cups arranged in an arc behind him.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.description: A couple embrace while their children dance nearby, with ten cups forming a rainbow above them. Their home stands in the distance under clear skies.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.description: A young person in a blue tunic decorated with floral patterns stands at a seashore, holding a cup from which a fish emerges. The fish symbolizes spiritual messages and creative inspiration.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.description: A knight in decorated armor rides a white horse, holding a cup carefully as he moves forward. His horse symbolizes the power of imagination, while his gentle approach represents romantic pursuit.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.description: A queen sits on a throne decorated with sea creatures, holding an ornate cup. Her throne is at the edge of the sea, symbolizing her mastery of the emotional and psychic realms.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.description: A king sits on a stone throne amid turbulent seas, yet remains calm. He holds a cup in one hand and a scepter in the other, symbolizing emotional mastery and authority.

suits.name: Suit of Pentacles
suits.description: The suit of material wealth, physical manifestation, career, and earthly matters. Associated with the element of Earth, representing stability, resources, and practical achievements.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.description: A divine hand emerges from a cloud, holding a large golden pentacle. Below is a lush garden with a path leading through an archway of flowers, suggesting opportunity and prosperity.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.description: A figure juggles two pentacles connected by an infinity symbol, while ships ride waves in the background, representing the balance of multiple material concerns.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.description: A craftsman consults with two others in a cathedral, showing his work. The pentacles are arranged in a triangle above them, symbolizing collaboration and mastery.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.description: A figure sits clutching a pentacle tightly, with three more pentacles at their feet and crown. The posture suggests both security and possessiveness.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.description: Two figures in tattered clothes walk through snow past a stained glass window with five pentacles. One figure uses crutches, suggesting hardship.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.description: A wealthy figure weighs coins on a scale while giving to beggars, suggesting charity and the fair distribution of wealth.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.description: A figure leans on their hoe, contemplating seven pentacles growing on a bush, suggesting assessment of long-term investments.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.description: An apprentice carefully crafts pentacles, with six completed ones displayed above. The scene shows dedication to mastering a craft.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.description: A well-dressed woman stands in a lush garden with a hooded falcon, surrounded by nine pentacles, representing self-made abundance.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.description: An elderly figure sits with dogs in a courtyard of a great estate, with family members nearby and ten pentacles arranged in the Tree of Life pattern.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.description: A young person stands in a meadow, gazing intently at a pentacle they hold, suggesting studious contemplation of material matters.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.description: A knight sits on a stationary black horse in a plowed field, carefully contemplating a pentacle, representing methodical progress.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.description: A queen sits in a lush garden, cradling a pentacle in her lap. Her throne is decorated with nature symbols, representing material abundance and nurturing.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.description: A king sits on an ornate throne adorned with bull and vine carvings, holding a pentacle scepter, representing material success and business acumen.

suits.name: Suit of Swords
suits.description: The suit of intellect, conflict, decisions, and mental activity. Associated with the element of Air, representing thoughts, communication, and challenges.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.description: A divine hand emerges from a cloud, holding an upright sword crowned with a golden crown. White lilies and roses adorn the scene, representing pure thought and intellectual victory.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.description: A blindfolded figure sits holding two crossed swords, with a crescent moon and sea in the background, representing difficult choices and mental stalemate.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.description: Three swords pierce a red heart against a stormy sky, representing heartbreak, sorrow, and emotional pain transformed through understanding.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.description: A knight lies in repose on a tomb, with three swords hanging above and one on the side. A stained glass window suggests spiritual contemplation.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.description: A figure gathers swords while others walk away in defeat. The stormy sky and scattered clouds suggest conflict and hollow victory.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.description: A ferryman poles a boat carrying a woman and child, with six swords standing upright. The waters ahead are calm, suggesting transition to peace.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.description: A figure sneaks away from a camp carrying five swords, leaving two behind. Their expression suggests cunning and deception.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.description: A blindfolded woman is bound and surrounded by eight swords, yet the bonds are loose and escape is possible, suggesting self-imposed limitations.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.description: A figure sits up in bed, face in hands, with nine swords on the wall behind them. The dark night suggests anxiety and mental anguish.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.description: A figure lies face down with ten swords in their back. The dawn breaks on the horizon, suggesting that the darkest hour comes before dawn.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.description: A youth stands on a hilltop with a raised sword, their hair and cloak blown by strong winds, representing vigilance and new ideas.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.description: A knight charges forward on a white horse, sword raised, charging into strong winds and turbulent clouds.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.description: A queen sits on a throne with a raised sword, facing forward with a stern expression. Clouds and a bird in flight suggest clear vision and independence.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.description: A king sits on a throne adorned with butterflies and angels, holding an upright sword, representing intellectual authority and ethical leadership.

core_systems.title: The Court Cards
core_systems.summary: The 16 royal cards representing personality types and levels of mastery.
core_systems.content: Each suit has four court cards: Page (Earth), Knight (Air), Queen (Water), and King (Fire), representing different aspects and maturity levels of that suit's energy.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.description: A free spirit eager to explore and learn, bringing news of opportunities.

core_systems.title: Tarot Spreads
core_systems.summary: Traditional and Enochian-specific layouts for card reading.
core_systems.content: Various spread patterns used for different types of divination, from the simple three-card spread to the complex Celtic Cross.

spreads.name: Celtic Cross
spreads.description: A comprehensive spread showing past, present, future, challenges, and potential outcomes.

core_systems.title: Tarot Correspondences
core_systems.summary: Connections between Tarot and other mystical systems.
core_systems.content: The Tarot's relationship with astrology, Kabbalah, and Enochian magic.
